Volcano plot functions

Source: R/fig_volcano.R
fig_volcano.Rd

Static (ggplot2) and interactive (plotly) volcano plots. Both share a common data preparation step and respect the exploration/publication theme mode.

Usage

fig_volcano(
  res,
  lfc_thr = 1,
  padj_thr = 0.05,
  n_label = 20,
  col_up = "#C0392B",
  col_down = "#2980B9",
  col_ns = "#BDC3C7",
  col_cut = "#7F8C8D",
  pt_size = 1.8,
  xlab = NULL,
  ylab = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  show_title = TRUE,
  show_subtitle = TRUE,
  leg_pos = "Right",
  x_min = NULL,
  x_max = NULL,
  y_max = NULL,
  glow = FALSE,
  mode = c("exploration", "publication")
)

Arguments

res

DE results

lfc_thr

log2FoldChange threshold

padj_thr

padj threshold

n_label

number of top genes (by padj) to label with ggrepel

col_up, col_down, col_ns, col_cut

colors for regulation classes and threshold lines

pt_size

point size

xlab, ylab, title

axis and plot labels

show_title, show_subtitle

whether to draw title / subtitle

leg_pos

legend position keyword

x_min, x_max, y_max

optional axis limits

glow

if TRUE, draw a soft halo behind significant points

mode

"exploration" or "publication"

Value

a ggplot2 object
